title: CAT 2021 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Time and Work
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: Anu, Vinu and Manu can complete a work alone in 15 days, 12 days and 20 days, respectively. Vinu works everyday. Anu works only on alternate days starting from the first day while Manu works only on alternate days starting from the second day. Then, the number of days needed to complete the work is
questions.explain:
Let the total work be the LCM of (15, 12, 20) = 60 units.
Efficiency of Anu = $60/15 = 4$ units/day.
Efficiency of Vinu = $60/12 = 5$ units/day.
Efficiency of Manu = $60/20 = 3$ units/day.
Day 1: Anu and Vinu work $\implies 4 + 5 = 9$ units.
Day 2: Manu and Vinu work $\implies 3 + 5 = 8$ units.
Work done in a 2-day cycle = $9 + 8 = 17$ units.
In 3 cycles (6 days), total work completed = $17 \times 3 = 51$ units.
Remaining work = $60 - 51 = 9$ units.
On the 7th day, it's Anu's and Vinu's turn, and they can do exactly 9 units in 1 day.
So, the work is completed exactly at the end of the 7th day.

questions.q: Amar, Akbar and Anthony are working on a project. Working together Amar and Akbar can complete the project in 1 year, Akbar and Anthony can complete in 16 months, Anthony and Amar can complete in 2 years. If the person who is neither the fastest nor the slowest works alone, the time in months he will take to complete the project is
questions.explain:
Convert all times to months: 1 year = 12 months, 2 years = 24 months.
Let rates of Amar, Akbar, Anthony be $a, b, c$ respectively.
$a + b = 1/12$
$b + c = 1/16$
$a + c = 1/24$
Adding all three equations:
$2(a + b + c) = \frac{1}{12} + \frac{1}{16} + \frac{1}{24} = \frac{4}{48} + \frac{3}{48} + \frac{2}{48} = \frac{9}{48}$.
$a + b + c = \frac{4.5}{48}$.
Now, find individual rates:
$c$ (Anthony) = $(a+b+c) - (a+b) = \frac{4.5}{48} - \frac{4}{48} = \frac{0.5}{48} = \frac{1}{96}$.
$a$ (Amar) = $(a+b+c) - (b+c) = \frac{4.5}{48} - \frac{3}{48} = \frac{1.5}{48} = \frac{1}{32}$.
$b$ (Akbar) = $(a+b+c) - (a+c) = \frac{4.5}{48} - \frac{2}{48} = \frac{2.5}{48} = \frac{5}{96}$.
Rates in order: Akbar (5/96) > Amar (3/96) > Anthony (1/96).
The person who is neither fastest nor slowest is Amar.
Amar's time to complete the work = $1/a = 32$ months.
